in_hebrew.name: Herm
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God of Hermes
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Herm הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Hermes is the messenger of the gods and the protector of travelers, merchants, and thieves. In Christianity, the name Herm may be derived from the Greek word ἥρμα, meaning 'cargo' or 'travel', symbolizing the spiritual journey.

in_greek.name: Herm
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God of Hermes
in_greek.long_meaning: Herm είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In Greek mythology, Hermes is the messenger of the gods and the protector of travelers, merchants, and thieves. In Christianity, the name Herm may be derived from the Greek word ἥρμα, meaning 'cargo' or 'travel', symbolizing the spiritual journey.

in_latin.name: Herm
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God of Hermes
in_latin.long_meaning: Herm est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. In Greek mythology, Hermes is the messenger of the gods and the protector of travelers, merchants, and thieves. In Christianity, the name Herm may be derived from the Greek word ἥρμα, meaning 'cargo' or 'travel', symbolizing the spiritual journey.
